notes: 0030: fix uploads stuck at Preparation / waiting for write when folders contain empty media files. Zero-byte photos and videos are deferred immediately so workers can upload the remaining files and continue other rules. The same check handles files emptied while waiting for stability. Deferred files create no upload records, fingerprints or reservations; monitoring detects them again when data appears and the source becomes stable. Show a separate deferred count and a clear zero-byte file status instead of reporting every file as uploaded. Existing account authorization, rules and upload history are preserved.
